children.author: reinsbr
children.text:
AI assistants and agents are finally capable of real work and day-to-day tasks, with new solutions enabling agentic credit card payments for humans. But until today, there was no solution that kept credentials out of an agent’s context, preventing theft and unauthorized actions, while moving with users from agent to agent. That’s why Self Labs is launching Agent Vault, a payment and login layer for AI agents to sign in and complete purchases on a human’s behalf without ever seeing or storing their information.

Superpowers for your Agents.
